item.title: Message Home: Quick Check-In on the Return Trip
item.description: The visitors sent a message home while on their return trip. What they said is nothing like what we experienced.

item.title: After They Left: Living in the Shadows
item.description: They came, did their thing, and left. Now all we have is the debris, the silence, and the questions that won’t go away.

item.title: While They Stayed: The World in Chaos
item.description: They were here for a few hours, and the world couldn’t handle it. This is what it was like while they stayed.

item.title: The Day They Came: A Stranger's Recount
item.description: They came from the sky, and nothing’s been the same since. This is what I’ve pieced together about that day.
